newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-League of Ireland premier division fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-League of Ireland premier division fixtures.

text.p: This weekend's national league of Ireland premier division fixtures. All kick-off times are given in GMT.
Shelbourne vs Bohemians at Tolka Park, 1945 GMT.
Derry City vs Home Farm/Everton at Brandywell, 1930 GMT.
Bray Wanderers vs Dundalk at Carlisle Ground, 1500 GMT.
Cork City vs Sligo Rovers at Turners Cross, 1400 GMT.
St.Patrick's Athletic vs Shamrock Rovers at Richmond Park, 1430 GMT.
University College Dublin vs Finn Harps at Belfield, 1515 GMT.
